integrity: The complete two-shore finite enumeration is independently recomputed by two standalone Python standard-library scripts. No claim of external certification or independent human validation is made.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for the 30-vertex Tutte–Coxeter graph under deterministic, synchronous, open-neighbor binary majority. It is not a uniform theorem for other cubic cages. Historical priority remains qualified; external audit is not performed.
title: Tutte–Coxeter majority dynamics: eighteen graph types and a four-step clock
